author: phase23-agent
scope: Screen OUR OWN native TabPFN-3.5 raw-context 8-estimator member (Kaggle T4 execution of research/phase23/kaggle/raw8/main.py) against the protected champion v7 on the immutable primary folds. No public-leaderboard optimization anywhere in this protocol. This protocol authorizes zero submissions; any upload would require a separate decision under research/submission_policy_amendment_20261017.md.
hypothesis: The external raw-context 8-estimator TabPFN-3.5 vector (tabpfn35) adds a small but consistent positive delta to v7 on our labels (+2.99e-5 pooled at w=0.10, 5/5 folds positive, paired SE 4.97e-6). If that effect is a property of the raw-context 8-estimator recipe (rather than of the producer's foreign fold assignment or an unaudited artefact), then OUR OWN raw8 member -- our immutable primary folds (seed 20261010), our pinned checkpoint, our route=False geometry, official n_estimators=8 -- reproduces a mean paired fold delta of the same order of magnitude on the primary endpoint.

external_reference.name: tabpfn35
external_reference.why_ineligible: produced with the producer's own fold assignment (reported StratifiedKFold(5, seed 42)) and unverifiable preprocessing/seed; retained as a diagnostic magnitude only, never certifiable.

member_recipe.execution: Kaggle script kernel jamesripoll/s6e10-phase23-raw8-tabpfn35, 2 x Tesla T4, free Kaggle quota, zero local GPU time
member_recipe.data: 21 raw columns (route=False geometry), the four meta columns coded to contiguous integers in columns [13,14,15,16], fillna -1, float32; outer context = every FIT row of the immutable primary fold (559,708 rows); prediction of the fold's val rows (139,927 per fold) and of the full test set (299,844 rows) for every member
member_recipe.model: TabPFNClassifier(model_path=Prior-Labs/tabpfn_3_5@06bf2ba35c80a92a3b9abb436b99cf49e7a0365e (sha256 ece4d67eadfea42eb0e610df5189bea60cb7f31073d81e9c7a019b76eacf0be3), n_estimators=8, auto_scale_n_estimators=False, random_state=1201, device=cuda, ignore_pretraining_limits=True, fit_mode=fit_with_cache, kv_cache_precision=int8, keep_cache_on_device=True, inference_precision=autocast, categorical_features_indices=[13,14,15,16], memory_saving_mode=True, n_preprocessing_jobs=1)
member_recipe.aggregation: official logits_to_probabilities over the 8 raw member logits with the recorded scalars (softmax_temperature, average_before_softmax, balance_probabilities) captured from the fitted classifier
member_recipe.port_equivalence_gate: in-kernel probe step A: stock predict_proba vs ported prepare/engine vs ported+lean-patched must agree within 2e-6 absolute max difference; the probe must fail rather than proceed otherwise

candidate_definitions.port_raw8: expit((logit(raw8_oof) + logit(aux10_oof))/2) -- the certified portfolio composition used by evaluate_phase16_fold.py with the route member replaced by raw8; the evaluator first checks that the same composition on (route2_oof, aux10_oof) reproduces v7_oof within 1e-5; if that check fails the candidate is dropped and the failure is reported

reproduction_target.note: same order of magnitude required; exact equality not required (different seeds, different preprocessing pipeline)

decision_rules.pass: candidate(s) meeting the numerical gate are recorded as NOMINATE_MATCHED_SHADOW: a matched shadow-fold (seed 777001) confirmation of our own raw8 would then require its own prereg + Kaggle run and a resource decision; still zero submissions by this protocol.
decision_rules.fail: record NO_ADMISSION with the numbers in experiments/ledger.jsonl; the raw-context-8 hypothesis is closed at the certified-evidence level (the external diagnostic remains ineligible).
decision_rules.partial: if any fold has fewer than 8 val members or any fold is missing, record OUTCOME_PARTIAL and do not compute the gate; no promotion decision is possible from incomplete evidence.

cost.note: Kaggle free-tier session <= 12 h; the local 22 h GPU budget and the submission budget are untouched by this protocol

known_deviations: Environment: Linux/Kaggle image with tabpfn==9.1.0 installed from pip; the certified local route runs used Windows + tabpfn 9.1.0. Numerics may differ within float tolerance; no bitwise cross-platform claim is made (this member is new, so no historical bitwise obligation attaches to it).
Precision: T4 (sm_75) does not support bf16, so the kernel falls back to fp16 autocast -- the same regime as the public producer's T4 runs for the tabpfn35 reference.

Memory: the stock fit_with_cache KV-build path is unchunked and OOMs on a 16 GB card, so a third-party lean KV-build patch (hemingweb public notebook, ported) is used; its equivalence is validated in-kernel at the 2e-6 gate.
Prediction batch 32768 with OOM fallbacks (the certified local runs used 1024).
Test predictions may be skipped for units that run out of session time; val (OOF) evidence is always prioritised for durability.
Model random_state is ours (1201); the external producer's seed is unknown. Member identity is defined by the recipe above, not by matching the external vector numerically.
stop_rules: Never bypass the local GPU hardware stop; this protocol runs only on Kaggle.
Never alter src/submission guards, never upload without a committed SUBMISSION_DECISION under PATH A/B.
If the probe's equivalence gate fails, stop and report instead of running production.
If the Kaggle session dies mid-run, record the partial units; no gate computation from incomplete folds.
